content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must send their detailed CV along with required copies of documents/certificates through Speed Post to the following address on a single line: Dr Kausik Mandal, Professor & Head / Nodal Officer, Centre of Excellence, Dept. of Medical Genetics, SGPGIMS, Raebareli Road, Lucknow 226014 (India) In addition to sending the physical documents by Speed Post, candidates must also submit a copy of their application and documents via email to [email protected] . Both the physical dispatch and email submission must reach the designated authorities on or before 30 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.text: The recruitment details regarding essential qualifications, experience, age limit, and remuneration for the post are as follows: Post Name: Technical Coordinator Total Vacancy: 01 (One) Type of Engagement: Contractual Term of Employment: One year (extendable as per requirement of the CoE) Reporting To: Nodal Officer, CoE for Rare Diseases Age Limit: Up to 45 years (as on the closing date of application) Educational Qualification: Master's in Public Health / Community Medicine / Health Management / Hospital Management / Public Health Informatics and related subjects OR MSW or equivalent from a recognised University. content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Technical Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: The Key Responsibilities assigned to the Technical Coordinator include: Act as a focal point for the Rare Diseases Clinic at the CoE. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination, and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations, and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review, and approval processes for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments, and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinate with spokes in matters of proposal for equipment and consumables procurement, demand for funds, and submission of Utilization Certificates. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and internal reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings, and awareness programs at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs, and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counseling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach required copies of documents and certificates along with their CV, including: Date of Birth (DOB) certificate Academic Qualification certificates Professional Qualification certificates Experience Certificate Other supporting documents/certificates

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SGPGIMS Technical Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must reach by Speed Post and email on or before 30 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced for the Technical Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Technical Coordinator post at SGPGIMS Lucknow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the SGPGIMS Technical Coordinator?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's in Public Health, Community Medicine, Health Management, Hospital Management, Public Health Informatics or related subjects, OR an MSW or equivalent degree from a recognised University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required experience for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess at least 5 years of working experience in the public health sector, along with familiarity with public health systems for rare diseases and government health schemes.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the SGPGIMS Technical Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 45 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Technical Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 90,000, starting with a consolidated Rs. 60,000 per month with an annual increment of up to 5%.

faq.question: Q7. What is the term of employment for the Technical Coordinator?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis for an initial term of one year, extendable as per requirement of the Centre of Excellence.

faq.question: Q8. How should applications be sent for SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their CV and copies of supporting documents by Speed Post to Dr Kausik Mandal at SGPGIMS Lucknow, and also email them to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this vacancy?
faq.answer: Received applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email or phone for a written examination or personal interview at SGPGIMS Lucknow.

faq.question: Q10. Is any travel allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.
